NICE Guideline CG150: Headaches in Over 12s Diagnosis and Management | Publisher: National
Migraine Self-Care & Environmental Comfort
Migraine presents as episodic throbbing headache often accompanied by
nausea or sensitivity to light and sound. Comfort Measures: - Rest in a
quiet, dark room during acute attacks. - Apply a cool cloth or ice pack
wrapped in a towel to the forehead or temples. - Maintain regular sleep,
meal, and exercise schedules to reduce migraine frequency.
